prompts.prompt: Gritty photorealistic raster scenery for a post-apocalyptic American highway chase. Orthographic/isometric-like approximately 45-degree DOWNWARD camera, horizontal rightward travel, roofs and top surfaces visibly consistent with side surfaces. No sky or horizon, no side-on panorama, no perspective convergence. Soft upper-left daylight. Ash and concrete greys from light bone-grey to charcoal dominate, with restrained bleached pastel mint, pink, turquoise and cream accents. Weathered, dead, decayed Americana. Extremely detailed natural materials, convincing chipped concrete, spalled brick, faded paint, grime and dust; no cartoon outlines, vector polygons, illustration strokes, living people, vehicles, UI, readable labels or watermark. Transform the supplied road-layout reference into a ruined American urban arterial road plate. Preserve the wide 2:1 composition and exact roadway position: road runs completely horizontally from left to right, occupies approximately y=25% through 88%; straight parallel faded white lane markings, no turning road or intersection. Broad usable asphalt centre, uneven small potholes and patches. Upper shoulder is broken sidewalk slabs, rubble, sparse dead weeds and fragments of pale brick retaining wall. Lower shoulder is crumbled concrete and gravel. The uppermost 5–15% has ACTUAL TRANSPARENCY following the irregular silhouettes of rubble, dead twigs and cracked curb: solid objects entirely opaque, tiny contour feather only, holes between branches transparent. Everything below this irregular top edge is solid opaque terrain and roadway. No gradient opacity fade, no tall buildings on the road, no desert rocks or mountains. This is a reusable road plate; matching level edges at left and right for horizontal tiling.
